title: Amazon API Gateway Private API with AWS Lambda
description: Create an Amazon API Gateway Private API with AWS VPC Lambda proxy integration

introBox.headline: How it works
text: This pattern in CDK offers a example to generate an Amazon API Gateway Private API endpoint with a greedy proxy ("{proxy+}") and "ANY" method from the specified path, meaning it will accept by default any method and any path. The VPC Lambda function provided in JavaScript only returns the path.
